definition.simple: The growth zones of a plant where new cells are constantly being made.
definition.academic: A region of plant tissue, found chiefly at the growing tips of roots and shoots, consisting of actively dividing cells forming new tissue.

examples: The very tip of a growing root.
The tip of a new shoot on a tree.

common_misconceptions: Thinking plants grow uniformly everywhere like animals. They only grow at meristems.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Think of meristems as the 'factories' of the plant where new cells are manufactured.
